source: Read by hand at the pinned commit: the root fields src/schema.graphql declares, and the resolver modules (src/resolvers/Query.js, Mutation.js, Subscription.js, each a module.exports object) that src/index.js joins as `{ Query, Mutation, Subscription, ... }` and passes to ApolloServer. Query.info is declared but no module resolves it, so it is not expected (a resolver linked to it is extra).
